overview: Embark on a thrilling two-day journey exploring the historical wonders and entertainment of Cairo and its surroundings. From the iconic Pyramids to cultural landmarks, this itinerary is packed with unforgettable experiences.

stops.name: Queen's Pyramids of Khufu
stops.description: Three small pyramids east of the Great Pyramid, the tombs of Khufu's wives and mother
stops.address: Al Haram, Nazlet El-Semman, Al Haram, Giza Governorate 3512201, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Mosque of Muhammad Ali
stops.description: Ottoman alabaster mosque dominating the Citadel skyline, built by Muhammad Ali Pasha in the 19th century
stops.address: Salah al-Din, al-Ayyubi, Saladin, Cairo Governorate 4252360, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Bab al-Futuh
stops.description: Northern gateway of the Fatimid city walls, flanked by two massive semi-circular towers
stops.address: 1 Darb Al Keshta, El-Gamaleya, El Gamaliya, Cairo Governorate 4334111, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Tahrir Square
stops.description: Cairo's central public square and focal point of modern Egyptian political history
stops.address: El-Tahrir Square, محطة السادات، Qasr El Nil, Cairo Governorate 11512, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Mena House Hotel
stops.description: Historic 1869 royal hunting lodge turned luxury hotel with direct views of the Great Pyramid
stops.address: 6 Pyramids Road، Kafr Nassar, Al Haram, Giza Governorate 12556, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

stops.name: Al-Azhar Park
stops.description: 30-hectare landscaped park on a historic rubbish dump, with gardens, restaurants, and city views
stops.address: 10 Salah Salem St, El-Darb El-Ahmar, Al-Darb Al-Ahmar, Cairo Governorate 4294010, Egypt

stops.name: Cairo Opera House
stops.description: National performing-arts center on Gezira Island hosting opera, ballet, and symphony in its seven theatres
stops.address: Gezira St, Zamalek, Cairo Governorate 4270020, Egypt
stops.tip: Free entry — great for a budget stop

tips: Start your day early to avoid crowds at the Pyramids.
Wear comfortable shoes as you'll be walking a lot.
Stay hydrated, especially when visiting outdoor sites.
Consider local dining options for an authentic taste of Egyptian cuisine.
Keep your camera ready for stunning photo opportunities at each stop.
summary: Enjoy your adventure through Egypt's rich history and vibrant culture!
